soil_scout.title: Meet the Soil
soil_scout.description: Analyze the physical health of your garden soil to understand what plants will thrive in it.

0.title: Preparation & Gear Check
0.objective: Before you head out, gather your kit.
0.tip: Pro Tip: Soil tests are best done when the soil is slightly damp, but not soaking wet from heavy rain.

1.title: Step 1 — The Harvest (Sampling)
1.objective: Collect a representative sample of your soil.

subSteps.0: Select 3 Spots: Pick three distinct areas in your plot (e.g., near a plant, center of the row, and an empty corner).
subSteps.1: Dig: Clear away surface leaves/mulch. Dig 6–10 cm deep (about finger-length).
subSteps.2: Collect: Scoop about 1 cup of soil from each spot into separate bags/jars.
subSteps.3: Label: Mark them clearly: S1, S2, S3.

1.tip: Why? Soil changes across a garden. Three spots give you an average, not an anomaly.

2.title: Step 2 — Texture Analysis (The Physics)
2.objective: Determine if your soil is Sandy, Silty, or Clay-heavy.

subSteps.0: Method A: Take a moist pinch of soil (add a drop of water if needed).
subSteps.1: Knead it into a ball, then press it between your thumb and finger to push out a 'ribbon.'
subSteps.2: Check Ribbon: Sandy (No ribbon), Silty (Weak ribbon), Clay (Strong ribbon >2cm).
subSteps.3: Method B: Fill a clear jar 2/3 with soil and top with water.
subSteps.4: Add a pinch of salt and shake vigorously for 2 minutes.
subSteps.5: Wait 24 Hours and observe layers (Sand bottom, Silt middle, Clay top).

subSteps.0: The Squeeze Test: Pick up a handful of soil and squeeze gently. Open your hand.
subSteps.1: Check if Dry: Falls apart immediately (Needs irrigation).
subSteps.2: Check if Moist: Holds loose shape but crumbles (Ideal).
subSteps.3: Check if Wet: Drips water, sticky blob (Poor drainage).

subSteps.1: Color Code: Dark Brown/Black (Rich Organic Matter).
